newsitem.title: USA: Pharmaceutical Product names new COO.
newsitem.headline: Pharmaceutical Product names new COO.

text.p: Pharmaceutical Product Development Inc said Wednesday it has named Thomas D'Alonzo, 52, as president and chief operating officer.
He replaces Peter Wise, M.D. who has retired as COO but will be retained as a consultant.

D'Alonzo, who will join the company immediately, formally was president of GENVEC, a gene therapy, early-stage biotech company where he worked three years, a statement from Pharmaceutical Product said.
D'Alonzo was president of Glaxo Inc from 1983 to 1993. Earlier, he was general counsel of Adria Laboratories.
